maria_sales: Heads up 1: ACME POC keeps failing auth. They see 403 with 'invalid_org_claim' even though their key shows active in console. Can eng take a look?

devx_ian: Paste the raw request + response and any request_id you have. Also which header values are they sending?

maria_sales: They sent this snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_ABCDEF123' \  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  -H 'X-Redwood-Org: acme-us' \  -d '{"model":"rw/gpt-3.5","input":"test"}'```
Response: `{"error":"invalid_org_claim","status":403,"hint":"token org 'acme-global' != header 'acme-us'"}`

chao_eng: That hint is clear: token claim is acme-global while header is acme-us. Likely they used a global service key (admin) but are sending a project/org header that doesn't match. Could be an onboarding artifact.

ops_ali: We pushed a policy change this morning that tightened org scoping. Any API keys created before 2026-02-15 could be global. We auto-minted project-scoped keys for new projects after that date.

maria_sales: Customer insists they copied the key from the project page. Could be they grabbed a different key from their vault. They only have the one engineer on the call.

devx_ian: Two quick remediations: 1) Rotate/create a new project-scoped key in Console -> Projects -> demo -> Keys -> Create. 2) As a temporary workaround, remove X-Redwood-Org header so the gateway uses token's org claim. Not ideal for multi-tenant apps. Recommend rotation for POC.

chao_eng: If they rotate, ask them to verify the new key's payload by decoding JWT header+payload (they can paste those parts, redact signature). If they prefer, send us request_id and we can decode server-side.

maria_sales: They also reported bursts of 429s earlier today when trying retries. Any quick quotas we can bump? They're on a trial project.

ops_ali: For trials we can temporarily raise project burst to 100 and steady to 10rps via Console -> Projects -> demo -> Quotas. Will document the change and revert in 48h. Need a ticket for audit.

devx_ian: Note: if they replay a bunch of failed requests after auth fixes, that will produce a retry spike. Tell them to exponential-backoff and to check SDK client retry settings.

maria_sales: On the pricing side, if they want sustained throughput, we should propose a 30-day Dedicated trial. I'll prepare a one-pager.

support_bot: support-bot: ticket #SUP-2026-472 opened for request_id=xyz-789, assigned to eng-triage.

chao_eng: Also adding a tiny diagnostics snippet they can run locally to confirm claims: ```# decode JWT (header.payload) without signature
python -c "import base64,json,sys; p=\"<redacted.header>.<redacted.payload>\".split('.') [1]; print(json.dumps(json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p+'==')), indent=2))"```

maria_sales: I'm telling them to rotate the key and to hold off on replays until we confirm quotas. I'll post the new curl here when they send it. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
